headline_marked: Meta's AI Can Now Remix [[Your Instagram Photos by Default]]
headline: Meta's AI Can Now Remix Your Instagram Photos by Default
summary: Meta's new AI image model uses public Instagram profiles to generate images. Users must opt-out to prevent their content from being used.
details: Meta launched its AI image model, Muse Image, which integrates with the Instagram app. Public Instagram profiles are automatically opted into being used for generative AI remixes.

Users can opt-out by navigating to the Sharing and reuse tab in the Instagram app's settings. There, they can toggle off 'Allow people to use your content on Instagram and with AI features on Meta' for Posts and Reels.

Existing AI images made with user content will not be deleted, even if the user opts-out or switches their account to private. Users will not be notified when their content is used to create AI-generated images.
caption:
Your Instagram photos can now be remixed by Meta's AI by default. Here's how to opt-out:

Meta launched its AI image model, Muse Image, which integrates with the Instagram app. Public Instagram profiles are automatically opted into being used for generative AI remixes.

Users can opt-out by navigating to the Sharing and reuse tab in the Instagram app's settings. There, they can toggle off 'Allow people to use your content on Instagram and with AI features on Meta' for Posts and Reels.

Existing AI images made with user content will not be deleted, even if the user opts-out or switches their account to private. Users will not be notified when their content is used to create AI-generated images.

Source: Wired

headline_marked: X Introduces [[In-App Video Editor]] to Tackle Stolen Content
headline: X Introduces In-App Video Editor to Tackle Stolen Content
summary: X launches in-app video tools to encourage original content and combat stolen videos.
details: X has launched a new in-app video editor and recorder in its iOS app, aiming to encourage users to post original content. The platform's head of product, Nikita Bier, stated that many top accounts steal videos from other users, sometimes years after they originally went viral.

The new video tools include features such as overlaying captions in multiple languages, a 'green screen' feature for adding custom backgrounds, trimming videos, and automatically generating captions. These features are designed to make content creation easier and more engaging for users.

X has been taking steps to address the issue of stolen content, including allocating impressions from reuploaded posts to the original creator and cutting back on payouts to 'aggregators' sharing stolen reposts and clickbait. The platform aims to promote original content and reward creators who produce unique material.

The new video tools are part of X's efforts to increase user engagement and encourage more users to post original content. By providing a more user-friendly video editing experience, X hopes to attract more creators and improve the overall quality of content on the platform.
